content: Phase 77 plan: docs/phases/panel-turn-notice.md (roadmap entry added). Field report from QA 3.14.11: on paneled impl turns the interactive Codex pane is never sent the turn (correct), and nothing tells the arbiter, who nudged the pane every round and got reviews outside the panel. Evidence in the plan Summary. Proposal: desktop notification when run_panel claims an attempt (new optional notify arg, briefer-style) and when _maybe_panel gets merged; a watcher start line in pane modes; one contract sentence in both SKILL.md copies. Rejected with reasons: writing into the Codex composer (_recover_stuck_codex would Enter it), renaming the tab (agent CLIs own the title, measured). No change to panel behaviour. Planning only, no code yet.

Approved. Reviewed the plan against run_panel claim/early-return paths, PanelResult, _maybe_panel, the startup banner, and existing panel tests. The optional best-effort notifier fits the existing flow without changing panel decisions or dispatch. Implementation notes: derive the banner cycle names from panel.on rather than hard-coding impl; preserve the ordinary-reviewer fallback exception in the contract sentence; keep the merged-verdict notification best-effort too. Plan review only; no tests run.
